why: Chocolate is made from roasted, ground cacao beans.
pearl: Cacao beans were once used as money by the Aztecs.

why: Tigers are the largest wild cats.
pearl: No two tigers have the same stripe pattern.

clue: Galloping animal. Big race day in Melbourne today.
why: Horses have been domesticated for about 5,000 years.
pearl: Horses can doze standing up, thanks to a locking system in their legs.

clue: Mountain that occasionally loses its temper.
why: A volcano is an opening where molten rock, gas and ash escape from the Earth.
pearl: The word comes from Vulcan, the Roman god of fire.

clue: Firework that whooshes up. Or a ride to space.
why: Rockets push themselves forward by blasting gas out of the back.
pearl: Gunpowder rockets were invented in China around 800 years ago.

clue: Largest land animal, with a trunk.
why: Elephants are the largest land animals on Earth.
pearl: They can sense rumbles through their feet.

why: A keyboard is the set of keys you type on.
pearl: The QWERTY layout dates from typewriters in the 1870s.

clue: Insect that starts life as a caterpillar.
why: Butterflies change from caterpillar to adult inside a chrysalis.
pearl: Many butterflies taste with their feet.

clue: Flatbread with toppings, born in Naples.
why: Pizza is a flatbread baked with toppings, from Naples in Italy.
pearl: The margherita is said to be named after Queen Margherita of Italy, in 1889.

why: The Moon orbits Earth about once every 27 days.
pearl: It drifts about 3.8 cm further from Earth every year.

why: A camera captures light to make a picture.
pearl: The first photo with a person in it was an accident, taken in Paris around 1838: a man having his shoes shined.

why: Dolphins are marine mammals that use clicks to find food.
pearl: They sleep with half their brain at a time.

why: An umbrella is a folding canopy that keeps off rain or sun.
pearl: Opening one indoors is meant to be bad luck. It is definitely bad luck for whoever’s standing nearby.

clue: Small, spiky and rolls into a ball.
why: Hedgehogs are small spiny mammals that curl up when threatened.
pearl: A hedgehog has around 5,000 to 7,000 spines.

clue: Boat that likes to go under.
why: A submarine is a vessel that travels underwater.
pearl: An early working one was rowed under the River Thames in the 1620s.

why: Cake is a sweet baked food, usually made with flour, sugar and eggs.
pearl: The word comes from the Old Norse kaka.

why: Lemons are a citrus fruit full of citric acid.
pearl: Lemons are thought to be a hybrid of bitter orange and citron.

why: Giraffes are the world’s tallest animals.
pearl: They have the same number of neck bones as you: seven.

why: Pirates robbed ships at sea.
pearl: One theory says eyepatches kept one eye ready for the dark below deck.

why: A snowball is packed snow, best thrown at a friend.
pearl: Snow is actually clear. It looks white because ice crystals scatter all colours of light.

why: Astronauts are trained to travel and work in space.
pearl: Astronauts can grow up to about 3% taller in space as their spines stretch.

clue: Big reptile with a famous smile.
why: Crocodiles are large reptiles that live in tropical rivers and coasts.
pearl: They can’t stick their tongues out.

clue: Hops, croaks, starts as a tadpole.
why: Frogs are amphibians that start life as tadpoles.
pearl: Many frogs drink through their skin.

why: Sheep are farmed for wool, meat and milk.
pearl: Sheep can recognise individual faces, of sheep and humans, for years.

why: Pyjamas are loose clothes for sleeping in.
pearl: The word comes from Hindi and Urdu, meaning “leg garment”.

why: Oranges are a citrus fruit.
pearl: The fruit was named first. The colour was named after it.

why: Lightning is a giant electrical spark in a storm.
pearl: A bolt is about five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.

why: A marathon is a long-distance running race.
pearl: It became 42.195 km because of the route at the 1908 London Olympics.

why: A telescope gathers light to show distant objects.
pearl: Galileo pointed one at Jupiter in 1610 and found four moons.

why: A train is a line of carriages that runs on rails.
pearl: The first public steam railway, the Stockton and Darlington, opened in England in 1825.
